Re-read at tag 5f5440bb and wiki docs@de3550c9. Normalized deprecated.md and changelog.md are identical. Registry rows: Roots, Sampling, Logging, Dynamic Client Registration, includeContext thisServer/allServers, HTTP+SSE. Heading Removed says none removed under the policy. Changelog majors are a separate removal list.
Roots deprecated in 2026-07-28 (SEP-2577), still in the spec. notifications/roots/list_changed is removed (changelog major 5). PLAN N8: no capability, no handler.
Sampling deprecated in 2026-07-28 (SEP-2577). An inputRequest of sampling/createMessage fails closed (MRTR-C-8). Not implemented.
includeContext thisServer and allServers deprecated (SEP-2596, registry). Sampling itself is not implemented, so the field is never sent.

Logging deprecated (SEP-2577). Changelog major 5 removes logging/setLevel and still describes io.modelcontextprotocol/logLevel. PLAN N8 forbids sending logLevel. Wire negative check is WIRE-LOG-1. This row is the operations absence claim. Spec-versus-plan difference is flagged below.
rows.default: do not send logLevel; do not advertise logging

rows.condition: Dynamic Client Registration deprecated (PR 2858) and still allowed for back-compat. The default never calls registration_endpoint; explicit dynamicRegistration host opt-in is back-compat only. Auth negative check is AUTH-DCR-1.
rows.default: default never called; host opt-in for back-compat only

rows.condition: HTTP+SSE deprecated since 2025-03-26 (SEP-2596). Not a transport this library implements. Wire negative check is HTTP-SSEOLD-1.
InputRequiredResult only on prompts/get, resources/read, and tools/call. This closes the section 8.3 question: prompts/get is in the table.
rows.default: treat any other method as out of scope

rows.condition: input_required on any other method, including discover, lists, subscriptions/listen, and completion/complete, is protocol-violation.
At least one of inputRequests or requestState. Neither present: client protocol-violation.
If inputRequests is present, construct every requested input before retry.
rows.default: no retry until each input is built or the round fails

rows.condition: If inputRequests is absent, the client MAY retry immediately. Default delay 0, still under the round cap.
rows.default: retry immediately when only requestState is set

rows.condition: Echo requestState exactly. MUST NOT inspect, parse, modify, or assume its contents. Logs may carry length and a sha256 prefix only.
If requestState is absent, the retry MUST NOT include one.
Retry is a new JSON-RPC id. Original params stay; add inputResponses and requestState only when present.
inputRequests and requestState apply only to that logical call, not to parallel calls.

Servers MUST NOT send inputRequests the client did not declare. sampling/createMessage, roots/list, an unknown method, or elicitation/create in an undeclared mode: protocol-violation, nothing fabricated, no retry. Roots and sampling are deprecated (N8).
Plan 11.3 cap, not a spec number: maxRounds default 8.
Plan deadline default 5 minutes. Consent wait is outside the per-request timeout and inside the overall deadline. Not a spec number.
PLAN.md durable adapter. auto returns the final outcome. manual returns mrtr-interim data the host can persist; the closure itself is not persisted.
Abort during consent: cancel the port, send no retry, outcome cancelled phase input. The initial request already finished. No UI shell (N16).
rows.default: cancelled at phase input; no retry

rows.condition: Declare elicitation on each request only for modes with a working port. form if ElicitationPort.form is registered; url if url port and BrowserPort are registered. Omit the key when neither is. An empty object means form, so do not send it unless the form port exists.
rows.default: omit elicitation when no port is registered

rows.condition: A declared elicitation capability MUST support at least one of form or url.
rows.default: never declare elicitation with no mode

rows.condition: Missing mode is form. url only when that mode was declared.
rows.default: treat a missing mode as form

rows.condition: Flat object of primitives: string, number or integer, boolean, single-select enum, multi-select enum, optional defaults. Tag schema ElicitRequestFormParams.requestedSchema properties are PrimitiveSchemaDefinition only.
